_about: Confirmed decisions governing the Findigs GTM executive dashboard. Notion 'Data Definitions' is the system of record; this file is the bundled fallback and must match it. The refresh skill stops on any mismatch.

fiscal_year.note: Q1 Jan-Mar, Q2 Apr-Jun, Q3 Jul-Sep, Q4 Oct-Dec

terminal_stages.rule: Win/loss is derived from dealstage membership only. hs_is_closed_won / hs_is_closed_lost are unreliable on migrated records and are never used.

not_used.hs_projected_amount: reference only; equals amount x hs_deal_stage_probability

segment_rule.note: Raw deal 'segment' free text is displayed alongside but never used for grouping or filtering.

migration.rule: createdate on SALESFORCE-sourced records is the original Salesforce created date. Included everywhere with a footnote; native-only toggle available in Pipeline Generation. Sales-cycle tile shows all-deal mean with the post-cutoff mean alongside.

pipeline_generation.population: createdate >= fiscal year start, any dealstage
pipeline_generation.prior_period_comparison: prior quarter at the same elapsed-day count

populations.open: pipeline in scope AND dealstage not in terminal_stages
populations.won_fy: dealstage in terminal_stages.won AND closedate >= FY start
populations.created_fy: pipeline = new_logo AND createdate >= FY start

sdr_section.population: same population as pipeline_generation: pipeline = new_logo AND createdate >= FY start, any dealstage

not_used.sdr_owner_new: verified 2026-09-23: on the New Logo pipeline this diverges heavily from sdr_owner on the same deals (e.g. the two largest sdr_owner assignees hold only 9 and 13 records under sdr_owner_new, vs 866 and 801 under sdr_owner) — a team-reassignment pattern, not one field being more complete. sdr_owner confirmed authoritative; sdr_owner_new never used.
not_used.demo_completed_date__c: verified 2026-09-23: populated 0 times in Aug or Sep 2026 (vs demo_booked__c still populating) — appears abandoned since the Salesforce migration cutover. Not used for cohorting; meeting_held is a status flag only, no date.
not_used.attribution_source_drill_down: verified 2026-09-23: a distinct, independently-set field from deal_source_drill_down (diverges on sampled deals, e.g. one deal tagged 'Outbound SDR' on deal_source_drill_down but 'Conferences Outbound' on attribution_source_drill_down). This section continues to use deal_source_drill_down / deal_source_group for consistency with Pipeline Generation.
not_used.MEETING_EVENT: HubSpot engagement object considered and rejected 2026-09-23: 21,566 records portal-wide, dominated by an unrelated internal recurring sync ('Recurring Meeting Booked: Bridge | Findigs Monthly Sync', one series scheduled years into the future). Not sales demos; demo_booked__c / demo_completed__c are deal-level and purpose-built instead.

opportunity_definition.note: Not a HubSpot-governed concept — this is a Findigs-specific definition scoped to this section only. Deliberately broader than 'reached a later pipeline stage'; every deal an SDR owns counts as an opportunity from its create date.

channel_mapping.note: deal_source_group is a governed HubSpot field, independently set from deal_source_drill_down (not a pure lookup of it). 'referral' folded into Inbound by proposal — accepted 2026-09-23; that bucket is mostly Zoominfo / SalesIntel list-provider deals, not literal customer referrals.

rolling_window.rule: as_of date minus 29 days through as_of date, inclusive, America/New_York — same convention as the rest of the dashboard's ET-anchored windows
rolling_window.cohort_basis: cohort by trigger-event date (meeting_booked_date for metrics 1-2, createdate for metric 3), outcome evaluated as of the as_of date rather than requiring the outcome to also fall inside the window

pipeline_goals.status: PLACEHOLDER — no quota file exists yet. Values below are illustrative zeros only, never real targets; the build treats goal = 0 as "no goal configured" and does not compute a percent-to-goal against it. Replace this block wholesale when a quota workbook is supplied.

distribution.slack_dm_note: All errors/stops go here as a DM, never to slack_channel_id. slack_channel_id only receives successful-refresh posts.

notion.preflight_query: SELECT "Metric", "Formula", "Object & fields", "Scope / filters", "Exclusions", "Null handling", "Status" FROM "collection://75eddbb8-a6d4-41ff-b324-de338360c756" WHERE "Used by" LIKE '%GTM executive dashboard%' OR "Used by" LIKE '%Pipeline Generation section%' OR "Used by" LIKE '%SDR section%'
notion.note: Preflight compares each row's Formula / fields / scope / exclusions / null handling against the mapped config keys. Any row with Status other than Confirmed, or any semantic mismatch, stops the run.
